As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
  • Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
  • Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
  • Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.

  • Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.

  • Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.

Benefits

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Qualifikation

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools & Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. • An international team (with more than 30 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors

Your Role

Portfolio engagement and value creation

  • Lead portfolio engagement on Sustainability and Impact (S&I), providing hands-on support to portfolio companies and tracking S&I progress across ARCHIMED’s portfolios through dashboards, KPIs, and supporting processes.
  • Lead select portfolio value creation projects, collaborating with deal teams as well as guiding and project managing S&I interns where required.

  • Influence portfolio company management to advance their roadmaps through technical guidance and sharing of best practices.

  • Act as the bridge between deal teams and external providers during due diligence, critically assessing findings to confirm that each target is consistent with ARCHIMED’s S&I strategy and fund obligations.
  • Work with all ARCHIMED functions to review and improve how S&I is integrated into investment decision making.

  • Establish the tools and framework to collect, monitor, and coordinate S&I data across funds, enabling timely, accurate, and consistent reporting, and select third-party technical experts when necessary.
  • Analyze and interpret S&I data and substantially contribute to the production of ARCHIMED’s annual S&I report in line with industry standards and frameworks, turning data into clear narratives.
  • Contribute substantially to regular reporting to investors and to mandatory disclosures on fund S&I performance, ensuring credibility and transparency.
  • Monitor regulatory developments in ARCHIMED’s locations and sectors of focus, and help ensure compliance with sustainability-related requirements.

Center of excellence and capability building

  • Establish an S&I center of excellence across funds and portfolio companies, with tools, reports, and training materials that share guidance and best practices.

Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world's first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. Our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) images magnetic fields with micrometer resolution, and that capability could matter far beyond semiconductors. As our Technical Business Development Intern for Emerging Verticals in the Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development, you help us find out where.

Working directly with our project lead for Emerging Verticals, who mentors you, you explore new application fields for widefield magnetic imaging. You dig into the science and the markets behind them, talk to potential customers and users, and help turn promising ideas into first feasibility studies with our magnetic field imaging system. You see how a deep tech company decides where its technology goes next, and help shape that decision.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Map and evaluate application areas for magnetic field imaging beyond semiconductors: key players, customer segments and structured comparisons of use cases.

  • Review scientific literature and patents to understand the state of the art, competing measurement methods, and where NV-based imaging offers a real advantage.

  • Prepare and join discovery conversations with researchers and companies to understand their measurement challenges, and keep contacts and opportunities up to date in our CRM.

  • Support feasibility studies with our experts, from defining suitable samples to interpreting first measurement results.

  • Turn your findings into clear deliverables such as application one-pagers, decision memos, and presentations.

 

What is expected of you

  • Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in physics, engineering, materials science, chemistry, biophysics, or a related natural science or engineering field, ideally with some Python exposure.

  • Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

  • Curiosity about how a new measurement technology can solve problems in fields you may not know yet.

  • Clear writing and structured analysis: you turn a pile of papers and conversations into a one-page recommendation.

  • AI tools are part of how you research, analyze and write, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Business studies or first experience in market research, consulting, or a startup is a plus, not required.

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do

  • Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

  • Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

  • Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

  • Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

  • Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

  • Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

  • Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

  • Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

  • Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

  • Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

  • Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

  • Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

  • Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis.

What you’ll do

  • Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production

  • Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking

  • Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering

  • Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds

  • Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments

  • Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials

About you

  • Several years in supply chain, procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics)

  • Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production

  • A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality

  • Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts

  • A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver

  • Clear, concise communication in English and German

What Filics offers

  • Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production

  • A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility

  • Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

The Account Executive, Strategic, is responsible for managing and expanding relationships with key strategic accounts. Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships with strategic clients. Act as the main point of contact and advocate for client needs within the company.

  • Strategic Business Planning: Develop a thorough understanding of key client needs and requirements. Work closely with clients to devise and implement strategic plans that align with their business goals and drive mutual growth.

  • Relationship Building: Begin to establish relationships with key internal stakeholders, including sales, marketing, product, and customer support teams. Understanding their roles and how they can contribute to the success of strategic accounts is crucial.

First 90 Days:

  • Sales and Negotiations: Start actively pursuing new business opportunities within strategic accounts, which may involve negotiating terms for contracts or renewals. Efforts to cross-sell or up-sell should also be underway.

  • Achieving Sales Targets: By the one-year mark, you should have met or exceeded the initial sales targets set for your strategic accounts. This includes successfully closing new deals and expanding business within existing accounts.

We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Customer Success Manager

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our growing CS team in London, reporting to our Chief of Staff. You'll own a portfolio of clients — including hedge funds, oil majors, refiners, vessel owners and trading companies — and be responsible for their onboarding, adoption, retention and growth. As part of a small, global CS team, there's plenty of room to shape the role and grow with it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own onboarding, training and support for your client portfolio, driving product adoption and account health.

  • Build strong relationships with clients, understanding their workflows and challenges.

  • Partner with Sales to spot cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and manage renewal risk.

  • Feed client insight back to the Product team to help shape the roadmap.

  • Maintain and improve our Customer Success processes and tools.

  • Help build a company-wide culture centered on customer success.



About You

  • Some knowledge of, or experience in, oil & gas, commodities, or trading — you understand the world our clients operate in.

  • Experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success or Account Management — ideally supporting a data, intelligence, or SaaS product.

  • Comfortable using AI and automation tools in your day-to-day work, and curious to find smarter ways of doing things.

  • Strong communicator, comfortable building relationships and influencing stakeholders.

  • Analytical and process-minded — you like understanding what drives client value.

  • Proactive and comfortable with ambiguity — happy to figure things out and get stuck in.

  • High level of integrity and alignment with Sparta's values.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and their money should move with them. Every product, corridor and payment rail we add opens a new door for fraudsters. We want to be the least attractive target on our corridors, without adding friction for good customers. This role exists to own how we detect and deter fraud across every rail and geo.

You’ll lead fraud detection and deterrence end to end, from exposure mapping to rules, limits and customer protection. You report to our Head of Financial Crime and work alongside the fraud recovery and chargebacks lead. You partner with Product, Payments, Engineering, Customer Support and Compliance on every launch. You decide what ships on day one, and you own the trade-off between fraud caught and friction added.

Who You Are

You don’t see fraud as a dashboard to watch. You see it as a live contest, won or lost in seconds, and you’ve been in it.

  • You’ve done multiple rodeos. You’ve worked fraud at more than one fintech or high-velocity regulated platform across the UK, EU or US. That could be a neobank, payments company, gambling operator, gaming platform or crypto exchange. You know how attacks, rails and rules differ in each.

  • You’ve built controls from scratch. At a B2C fintech, you built fraud controls that didn’t exist before, while protecting consumer money at scale.

  • You’ve worked the floor. You started as an investigator and worked alerts and cases by hand. You spot a pattern before it shows on a dashboard.

  • You’ve been baptised by fire. You’ve handled a real fraud attack or loss spike and made fast calls under pressure. You stayed on it until the fix held, and learned from every case.

  • You own the approach. You decide how to tackle a problem and see it through end to end, without waiting to be told.

  • You see every launch as a new door. You map where fraud can get in before go-live, not after the first losses land.

  • You protect good customers too. You stop fraud without adding friction for the people we serve, and you can show the numbers behind it.

Most importantly, you’d rather build the right controls once, on our own decisioning platform, than tune vendor defaults forever.

What You’ll Own

This is a role with a mandate across every rail, product and geo we operate in.

  • See the exposure, everywhere. Map where fraud can hit us on every rail, product and geo, and own the observability layer that lets us watch it live.

We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As a Sales Lead at Scarlet you will lead a team of Account Executives in London, grow that team, as well as continue closing deals yourself. You will own your team's quarterly number and the pipeline behind it. Our sales team has grown fast and is about to grow faster so we'll need your help to continue to build the team and develop our talent.

You will carry a personal quota alongside your team target, which will be reduced as your team grows, so you stay close to customers and lead from live deals rather than from a dashboard. Our best salespeople know the product in depth, and we expect the same of you.

You will work day to day with our leadership team, Business Development Reps, Commercial Relations and Customer Experience. This is a full-time, in-office role in London where your team will also be located. You will be in front of customers across the UK and Europe, including at industry conferences and Scarlet-hosted events.

Responsibilities

  • Own your team's quarterly target and forecast. Run weekly pipeline reviews, inspect deals, and call commits accurately.

  • Coach AEs on their deals: join discovery and negotiation calls, review call recordings and give feedback, and work with AEs to map decision-makers, budget and signing process on every deal.

  • Hire AEs to grow your team: screen candidates, run interviews, make hiring decisions, and onboard them to set them up for success.

  • Practice what you preach: source, run and close your own deals with regulatory, quality and clinical leaders at AI and software medical device companies.

  • Share what works: write up deal learnings and losses for the wider sales team, and bring improvements to the playbook, qualification and pricing conversations.

  • Work with the BDR team on first-meeting-to-discovery conversion and with Commercial Relations on partner and consultant referrals.

  • Represent Scarlet with your team at industry conferences (for example MEDICA, RSNA) and at Scarlet-hosted events.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a quota-carrying Account Executive owning full-cycle deals

  • At least 1 year managing or formally leading quota-carrying salespeople, with responsibility for their targets

  • A track record of hitting or exceeding quota as an individual contributor, including in the year before you moved into management

  • Experience hiring salespeople: screening, interviewing and making hiring decisions

  • Experience selling a technical or expertise-led product to specialist buyers, with deal cycles of three months or more and multiple stakeholders

  • Experience running pipeline reviews and forecasting a team or territory number to senior leadership

  • Able to show how you have coached an underperforming AE back to target, with the evidence you used

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, London, with the right to work in the UK

Preferred qualifications

  • A STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Experience in selling to regulated industries

  • Experience as an early sales hire or first sales manager at a startup, where you helped build the process rather than inherit it

  • Experience selling into European markets outside the UK

Compensation and benefits

The base salary range for this role is £100,000 – £120,000 per year, with on-target earnings of £200,000 – £240,000. The actual base salary offered will depend on experience and skills. This role also includes equity in Scarlet and a competitive benefits package.

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Reporting to the Senior Director, Labor and Employee Relations, the Labor & Employee Relations (LER) Business Partner (EMEA) is responsible for conducting highly complex and sensitive investigations, identifying themes and trends and offer effective recommendations to resolve challenging employee relations matters.


The incumbent must have a strong background in Labor and Employee Relations and be able to work independently with guidance only in a range of complex situations.


This is a pivotal role in maintaining a positive employee and labor relations environment for all of our associates. In addition, the LER Business Partner will provide training, coaching and counselling to HR Business Partners and serve as a strategic thought partner to assigned business units.


This role is fully remote and can be based in France, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Czech Republic, or other approved EMEA locations, subject to business needs and local employment considerations. Occasional travel within EMEA may be required.

  • Lead highly complex and sensitive investigations into employee relations matters, including but not limited to discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and policy violations
  • Identify innovative solutions to business challenges by gathering and analyzing evidence, interview witnesses, and preparing detailed investigation reports and report outs
  • Provide guidance and support to management on labor relations issues, including union organizing campaigns, contract negotiations, and grievance resolution
  • Collaborate with business leaders and HR partners to understand the unique challenges and opportunities within assigned business units
  • Consult as a LER specialist on potential restructure business cases and proposals to terminate roles in EMEA

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, Business Administration, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • Significant experience in Employee Relations, Labor Relations, HR Business Partnering, or related HR roles, with a demonstrated track record of conducting complex investigations, influencing stakeholders, and delivering practical business solutions
  • Thorough understanding of local employment laws and regulations, as well as experience working with labor unions and collective bargaining agreements
  • Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity
  • Professional certifications such as CPID, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP are a plus

Language skills are important for this role. Fluency in English and French is required. Additional European language skills, particularly German or Turkish, would be advantageous. Candidates with strong Employee and Labor Relations expertise will also be considered if English is their primary business language.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our Digital Experience Lead, you’ll own how our Customer Experience team’s technology actually works. You’ll hold the roadmap for a stack of CX tools — think Zendesk, Zapier, Sprout and a handful of others — and make the call on what stays, what goes, and what gets replaced. You’ll lead the build-out of automations and AI-powered workflows that take the busywork off our CX team’s plate, partner closely with IT and Digital Product to land new tools properly, and lead and grow one direct report along the way. We’re moving into a new phase of scaling up our internal processes to match our growth, and this role is central to making that happen — think less “maintain what exists” and more “figure out how we do this better.”

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Reviewed our CX tech stack and made the case for consolidating two overlapping tools into one
  • Worked with the Analytics & Insights team to redesign our Zendesk issue-type taxonomy
  • Sketched out a 12-month roadmap of automation and AI experiments with Digital Product
  • Pushed back on a vendor renewal that didn’t stack up on cost, and proposed an alternative
  • Coached your direct report through a cross-functional roadblock with IT

Let’s talk about you

You lead without needing to be told howYou’ve led a team before and you’re used to making the call yourself, not waiting to be pushed into it. When something needs a recommendation, you bring one — with the reasoning attached.

You speak fluent tech, without needing to write the codeYou don’t need to be an engineer, but you understand technology well enough to pull apart a tool, weigh it against alternatives, and make a confident call on what we should actually be using. Hands-on time with tools like Zendesk, Sprout, Zapier, Kodif or similar CX platforms will help you hit the ground running.

You use AI as a toolkit, not a talking pointYou’re comfortable and confident using AI tools day to day, and you can see the practical ways they fit into automations and customer-facing workflows — not just the hype.

You give a crapDo you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off,as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world,generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Job Description

Role Summary

  • The U.S. Director of Medical Affairs (US DMA) - Ophthalmology position resides in the Value & Implementation (V&I) organization, which includes Global Medical and Scientific Affairs as well as Outcomes Research.
  • The US DMA is a regionally based position within U.S. Medical Affairs (USMA). This position strategically drives scientific excellence across in-line business and our company pipeline while optimizing field readiness across the USMA strategic pillars: 1) Scientific Exchange; 2) Company Trials; 3) Investigator-Sponsored Programs; 4) Congresses; and 5) Scientific Insights.
  • The US DMA is an experienced therapeutic area (TA) leader and subject-matter expert (SME) with relevant medical affairs and field medical experience.  This role is also responsible for driving execution of scientific and medical affairs plans for assigned TAs within their region, engaging with regional cross-functional teams, and providing U.S. input to the relevant cross-functional team meetings, e.g., U.S. Medical Affairs Team (MAT), Payor Access Team (PAT), Management Team (MT) and V&I Plans.
  • As a core member (or co-lead) of the U.S. MAT, the US DMA collaborates with the Global TA team and cross-functional partners to enable U.S. regional implementation of V&I Planning by:
    • Integrating local insights into Global Scientific Value Content (GSVC) and Center of Scientific Exchange Excellence (CSEE) plans.
    • Facilitating local adoption of GSVC and CSEE initiatives.
    • Leading development and execution of aligned local training programs.
    • Evaluating training effectiveness and application in the field.

Responsibilities and Primary Activities:

  • In collaboration with USMA Executive Director (ED) and Payer & Health Systems Payor & Access Strategy Lead (PHS PASL), conducts development and implementation of regional strategies aligned with headquarters V&I goals including defining a prioritized USMA Field strategy and implementation goals.
  • Contributes to the integrated U.S. Country Medical Affairs Plan (CMAP), including the U.S. Field Medical Plan (FMP)/Field Engagement Plan (FEP), and field training plan for assigned TA as a member of the USMA TA Leadership Team.
  • Identifies and prioritizes U.S. field resources, training needs and activities; and in collaboration with V&I Global Medical & Value Capabilities (V&I GMVC), ensures strategically aligned content and training and any other needed adult learning activities across the portfolio. This would also include the pull-through of pre- and post-congress regional training and content.
  • Develops a strategic and comprehensive scientific engagement plan and ensures scientific exchange aligns with the global scientific communications platform.
  • Ensures insights from advisory boards and field medical activities are actioned with relevant stakeholders, aligned with Country Medical Affairs priorities, and monitored for trends impacting future strategy.
  • In collaboration with relevant USMA stakeholders (e.g. PHS PASL), organizes expert input events (e.g., advisory boards, forums) with contracted scientific leaders and key stakeholders to address new indication implementation and/or emerging science.
  • Manages programs (i.e., patient support, education, risk management) as needed for appropriate and safe utilization of company medicines.
  • Partners with GSVC, CSEE, U.S. Global Clinical Trial Organization (GCTO), V&I Global Medical and Scientific Affairs (V&I GMSA) TA leads, and internal/external SMEs to orchestrate and deliver regional training as needed.
  • Participates in bi-directional information exchange and sharing of best practices across USMA roles and teams, including Payer & Health Systems.
  • Collaborates with the USMA Director of Implementation and Strategic Execution (DISE) to ensure consistent standards, processes and harmonization for training activities (e.g., clinical immersions, verbalizations, journal clubs).
  • Provides input into strategic congress priorities and participates in planning at key scientific congresses.
  • Continuously monitors health-care environment and emerging trends to optimize CMAPs and field execution plans.

Additional Responsibilities (as applicable)

  • Serves as a point of contact for development and maintenance of U.S. new-hire scientific foundational onboarding in collaboration with leadership and SMEs.
  • Works with USMA Leadership and V&I GMVC stakeholders to ensure consistent verbalization processes for new hires and tenured Regional Medical Scientific Directors (RMSDs) regarding new data, indications, and disease areas.
  • Provides support for the Investigator Studies Program (ISP) for assigned TA, including Areas of Interest consultation, dissemination, data highlights, training, and scientific review as requested by the V&I GMSA ED.

Required Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Minimum

  • An advanced degree (e.g., MD, PhD, PharmD) relevant to the TA-specific disease area and recognized medical expertise in the TA (ophthalmology).
  • A minimum of five years of medical affairs experience or equivalent clinical/research experience.
  • A minimum of three years of working in TA (clinical, research or pharmaceutical environment) or within a highly relevant TA with demonstrated scientific acumen.
  • Proven ability in strategic decision-making and planning, including helping the U.S. Executive Director prioritize initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Demonstrated execution excellence with a track record of leading complex projects, managing multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Embraces an AI-first mindset by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools and demonstrating a willingness to learn and implement new approaches, without requiring deep technical expertise.
  • Strong emotional intelligence to foster trust and respect within a complex, matrixed organizational structure.
  • Exceptional networking and partnerships skills to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.
  • Agile mindset as a change catalyst, committed to experimenting, learning and adapting in response to evolving business needs, and capable of driving continuous improvement.
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific concepts clearly in both one-on-one and group settings.
  • Deep knowledge of the U.S. health-care system, including national treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, and Office of Inspector General (OIG) compliance.
  • The ability to travel up to 40% (e.g., congresses).

Preferred

  • Field Medical Affairs experience.
  • University-level teaching experience and understanding of adult learning principles.
  • Experience with innovative pharmaceutical training platforms.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Ability to quickly assimilate new subject areas and work independently on complex problems

Help product teams understand how clinicians and care teams engage with UpToDate's clinical decision support products.

At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite supports millions of clinical decisions every day. As we continue to evolve our CDS and AI-enabled experiences, we need clear insight into what users engage with, which interactions drive meaningful action, where workflows lose momentum, and how product changes affect adoption and value.

As Lead Product Analyst, CDS Adoption & Engagement, you will focus on adoption, engagement, funnel behavior, and usage patterns across clinical decision support products. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Commercial, and customer-facing teams to turn product data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements.

This is not a reporting-only role. You will be expected to query product usage data directly, investigate patterns, and translate analysis into practical recommendations.

What You'll Do

  • Define and maintain adoption, engagement, funnel, and usage metrics for CDS products.
  • Query product usage data to analyze clicks, actions, user journeys, drop-offs, cohorts, segments, and usage patterns.
  • Analyze what users engage with, which interactions drive downstream action, and where workflows lose momentum.
  • Build dashboards and recurring views that help product teams monitor product performance and user behavior.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics for launches, pilots, MVPs, and experiments.
  • Identify insights that inform roadmap priorities, UX improvements, content needs, commercialization, and adoption strategies.
  • Help improve instrumentation and metric definitions so teams can rely on consistent, high-quality product data.
  • Translate analysis into clear recommendations for product, leadership, commercial, and customer-facing teams.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, business analytics, product operations, or a related role.
  • Strong ability to write queries independently using SQL or comparable data-querying tools.
  • Experience analyzing adoption, engagement, funnel metrics, click behavior, cohorts, segments, and usage patterns and generating insights that contribute to the product development strategy.
  • Comfort working with event-level product telemetry, data models, and imperfect instrumentation.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and actionable insights.
  • Experience building dashboards, recurring reports, or self-serve product analytics views.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Commercial, or Customer Success teams.

Preferred Background

  • Experience with healthcare, clinical workflow, enterprise SaaS, AI-enabled products, search, content products, or decision-support tools.
  • Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, product telemetry, event instrumentation, or customer journey analytics.
  • Experience with modern data platforms and business intelligence tools.
  • Experience analyzing qualitative and quantitative feedback together.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product teams have clear, trusted metrics for CDS adoption, engagement, funnels, and usage patterns.
  • PMs understand which interactions and workflows drive meaningful user action.
  • Usage analysis identifies opportunities to improve clinician and care team satisfaction, workflow fit, and repeat engagement.
  • Launches and experiments have clear success metrics and post-launch performance visibility.
  • Leadership has a clearer view of how CDS products are being used and where investment is creating value.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As a E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert, your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.

What You’ll Do:

  • Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.

  • Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).

  • Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.

  • Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented QC Reviewer to ensure the quality and consistency of robot manipulation video annotations produced by our annotation team. You'll review labeled video segments against a detailed style guide and reference examples, catch errors or inconsistencies, and provide clear, constructive feedback to annotators. This role is critical to maintaining the accuracy and reliability of training data used for robotics AI models.

Project Details:

  • Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotation QC
  • Location: Remote in India/Philippines﻿/Egypt/Mexico﻿/Indonesia/Malaysia/Brazil
  • Employment type: Freelance
  • Pay Rate: US$4.03/hour

What You'll Do

  • Review completed annotations of robot manipulation videos across three levels of labeling detail (atomic motion, skill/subtask, task/goal).
  • Cross-check annotator descriptions against all three camera views (overhead and both wrist-mounted cameras) to verify accuracy of described actions, object identification, and contact/grasp details.
  • Verify full coverage of each video — confirm there are no gaps in labeling, including idle or pause moments.
  • Check that descriptions accurately reflect what actually happened in the video, including failures, drops, or slipped grips — flagging any instances where outcomes were inaccurately described or "smoothed over."
  • Evaluate annotations for adherence to the style guide: correct vocabulary usage, spatial/directional accuracy, consistent terminology for objects and actions, and appropriate language variation (avoiding repetitive phrasing).
  • Identify recurring errors or patterns of confusion among annotators and report them to the team lead for calibration purposes.
  • Provide specific, actionable feedback on rejected or revised annotations, referencing the style guide and reference examples.
  • Participate in periodic calibration sessions with the team and client to align QC standards with evolving guidelines or edge-case resolutions.
  • Maintain a QC log or tracking sheet documenting review outcomes, common error types, and annotator performance trends (as required by the project).

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Excellent written English and strong reading comprehension — you'll be evaluating precise, nuanced language choices, not just checking for typos.
  • Exceptional attention to detail — able to catch subtle mismatches between video content and written description (e.g., a mislabeled grasp type, an incorrect object part, a missed failure event).
  • Strong grasp of spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, object parts like handles, lids, edges) to verify annotator accuracy.
  • Ability to apply a detailed, structured style guide consistently and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.
  • Comfort giving clear, specific, and constructive feedback to annotators (written feedback, not just pass/fail marks).
  • Reliable, self-directed work habits, with the ability to work independently while meeting review turnaround expectations.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in a QC, editing, proofreading, or annotation review role.
  • Experience with video annotation, data labeling, or transcription QA specifically.
  • Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation).
  • Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio, including review/approval workflows.

At the same time, we warmly welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences who are passionate about quality, teamwork, and making an impact.

Contract Duration: 15Nov26 to 31Jul27

Security Clearance: Current Secret level clearance is required at time of application.

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Quality Engineer to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data across modern cloud data platforms. This role is responsible for validating data ingestion, transformation, movement, and quality across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, ensuring business rules, lineage, and reporting requirements are met. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in ETL/ELT testing, data lake and lakehouse environments, SQL-based analysis, and Azure data technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Validate data ingestion, transformation, and movement across Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.

  • Test data completeness, accuracy, conformity, lineage, business rules, and exception handling.

  • Perform ETL/ELT, data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse testing.

  • Validate source-to-target mappings, schema changes, and transformation logic.

  • Verify batch, incremental, and CDC (Change Data Capture) processing.

  • Conduct large-volume data validation and reconciliation activities.

  • Assess data quality, auditability, and end-to-end data lineage.

  • Investigate and troubleshoot data defects using SQL and other analysis tools.

  • Collaborate with engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions meet functional and quality requirements.

  • Support test planning, defect tracking, and reporting activities using Azure DevOps or similar tools.

Requirements

  • Experience testing data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, or lakehouse solutions.

  • Strong knowledge of data validation techniques, data quality controls, and source-to-target mapping.

  • Experience validating structured and semi-structured data.

  • Advanced SQL skills for data analysis, reconciliation, and defect investigation.

  • Working knowledge of Python and PySpark for data testing and validation activities.

  • Experience with Azure data technologies, including:

    • Azure Databricks

    • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)

    • Azure Data Factory (ADF)

    • Delta Lake

    • Kafka and/or Event Hub

    • Azure DevOps

  • Familiarity with data profiling and data quality tools.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

Work With Us

At PLATO, we believe that great work happens when people feel supported, connected, and challenged in the right ways. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where experienced professionals share knowledge, mentor others, and contribute to solving complex, real‑world client projects.

      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
